item.title: Niihama Taiko Drum Festival — Guide
item.description: The Niihama Taiko Festival is one of the most powerful and spectacular festivals in Shikoku, held in mid-October in the industrial city of Niihama. Its stars are the taikodai — enormous, lavishly decorated drum floats, some over five metres tall, weighing several tonnes and covered in gold embroidery, each carried entirely on the shoulders of around 150 men. Teams from across the city hoist these giants aloft and parade them, competing to lift and ‘fight’ them in displays of raw strength, coordination and civic pride, accompanied by the beat of the drum inside and the roar of the crowd.

item.title: Ehime Events & Festivals: Niihama Taiko, Matsuyama Autumn & Uwajima Ushi-oni
item.description: Ehime’s festival calendar is anchored at one end by one of the largest and most physically intense portable shrine festivals in all of Japan, and at the other by a winter onsen illumination that turns the country’s oldest hot spring building into something from a fever dream. Between those poles, bull-demons rampage through Uwajima, Matsuyama fills with dancers, and the Seto Inland Sea reflects summer fireworks from the bridges of Shimanami Kaido.
